_provenance: One month of market-wide news, as each publisher published it. Headlines, standfirsts and section names are theirs, reproduced unchanged; the article stays on their site. A story is filed under this month by the publisher's own date where they gave one, and otherwise by the date this dashboard first saw it — so a story with `publishedAt: null` may sit one month later than it was published. Its own time is never invented: it stays null and renders as "time not published".

articles.title: Corporate offsites, incentive trips make a comeback as companies resume travel plans
articles.summary: Corporate offsites and incentive travel are recovering after geopolitical tensions disrupted bookings in the first half of the year. Companies are rescheduling deferred trips and planning fresh programmes across domestic and overseas destinations. Travel firms report growing demand for curated experiences, luxury villas, sporting events and large employee engagement gatherings.

articles.title: Reliance Industries expands fuel exports to Africa, Europe as West Asia conflict disrupts supplies
articles.summary: Reliance Industries has redirected fuel exports to Africa, the Mediterranean and other European markets to capitalise on supply disruptions caused by the West Asia conflict, lifting its market share in these regions by about 50%. The strategy helped drive record quarterly earnings for its oil-to-chemicals business as global refining margins surged.
